## How it was checked

- [ ] `npm test`, `npm run lint` and `npx tsc -b` in `frontend/`
- [ ] `pytest` in `backend/`
- [ ] `npm test` and `npm run typecheck` in `video/`, if it touches the videos
- [ ] Tried in the browser, on a computer and on a phone, if it changes a page
